posts.text: As per Corporate law, until pledged shares are revoked, the promoters hold the right to vote. So, it was the promoters themselves who voted against and defeated the resolution.

posts.text: Just a wild thought.. Promoter shares are pledged, and due to that voting was done by the lenders. Hence the -ve result. I could be completely wrong.
